label: One recurrence
subgoals: Sum the latencies of the operations on the cycle
Sum the iteration distances of its edges
Divide and round up to get the recurrence bound

label: RecMII over all cycles
subgoals: Compute the bound of every elementary cycle
Test candidate IIs by a positive-cycle check instead of enumerating cycles

label: Reading cycles from a loop body
section: Reading cycles from a loop body
subgoals: Locate each loop-carried edge and the chain segment it closes
Sum the segment's latencies and divide by the edge distance
Include carried dependences through memory that the tool cannot disprove
